sources.title: OpenCV homography and returned RANSAC inlier mask
sources.application: Use returned inliers only; a coherent wall is also planar, so RANSAC alone is not ground segmentation.

sources.title: OpenCV plane-induced homography
sources.application: Plane normal and camera-to-plane distance constrain homography; calibrated height supplies metric scale.

sources.title: OpenCV fisheye model
sources.application: Undistort points before projective homography fitting; raw fisheye coordinates do not obey a single planar homography.

sources.title: Zhou et al. Ground-VIO (2023)
sources.verified_scope: abstract read; full experimental replication unverified
sources.application: Uses camera-ground geometry and IPM ground features. Our implementation reuses fixed calibration; does not adopt IMU or claim their accuracy.

sources.title: Zhou et al. Accurate and Robust Scale Recovery (2021)
sources.application: Constant camera height and RANSAC plane geometry support scale estimation; not evidence that a gray pixel is floor.

sources.title: Xu and de Croon CUAHN-VIO (RAS 2025; preprint 2022)
sources.application: Content and uncertainty awareness addresses non-homography image content; learned model and IMU not adopted in this own-RGB patch.

sources.title: CUAHN-VIO author implementation
sources.application: Confirms 2025 publication and public ROS/OpenVINS/libtorch implementation; no weights installed.

sources.title: PBRT 4e ray-box slabs
sources.application: Ray-box interval intersection used for inverse projection. Transform calibrated camera rays by estimated map pose; remove a pixel if a fixed wall occludes its ground intersection.

decision: Combine registered map occlusion + calibrated horizon + ideal-pixel RANSAC + existing metric ground SE2. Do not equate own-start odometry with a registered map pose.
engineering_note: OpenCV RANSAC defaults; 3px geometry margin is a fixed DEV erosion, not uncertainty calibration.
